summary: HeartBeam, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into an At-The-Market (ATM) Equity Offering Sales Agreement with Titan Partners Securities LLC. Under the agreement, HeartBeam may sell up to $25,000,000 of its common stock from time to time through the agent under its existing Form S-3 shelf registration statement. Sales may occur via ordinary brokers' transactions on Nasdaq at market prices, block transactions, or other agreed methods. The agent receives a commission of up to 3% of gross proceeds. This is a routine capital-raising facility, not a special situation.
